artifacts.description: Merge main into feat/206-model-hash; lib.rs doc conflict resolved keeping both sides

acceptance_criteria: `pub fn sha256(bytes: &[u8]) -> [u8; 32]` in a new module, documented with the FIPS 180-4 citation. No `unsafe`, no new dependencies.

`pub fn model_hash(model: &serde_json::Value) -> String`: `"sha256:"` plus 64 lowercase hex digits of the SHA-256 of exactly the bytes `write_unpacked` writes for `model.json`. The result passes the existing manifest `model_hash` check.

`Document::refresh_model_hash(&mut self)` sets `manifest.model_hash` to `Some(model_hash(&self.model))`. `Document::cache_is_fresh(&self, recorded: &str) -> bool` is true only when `recorded` equals `model_hash(&self.model)`. `write_unpacked` and `write_sltwx` do not change: the golden files are still reproduced byte for byte.

Tests (no `occt`): FIPS 180-4 / NIST example vectors; padding boundaries 55/56/63/64/65 bytes; golden bracket.sltwx model_hash; refresh_model_hash / cache_is_fresh true, false after a change, false for a malformed recorded string.
All existing `swx-io` tests pass unchanged; no test is weakened or removed.
No `unsafe`, and `swx-io` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
